title: erophila verna subsp. obconica
intro: Erophila verna subsp. obconica, commonly known as Alpine Wintercress, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. Alpine Wintercress is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. Its bioactive constituents include glucosinolates, isothiocyanates, and other compounds that have been shown to have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
